I was unable to complete the task of forking all repos from facebook. Here's what I found:

1. Successfully signed into GitLab with provided credentials
2. Searched for 'facebook' repositories - found 0 projects but 1000+ issues and 84 merge requests related to facebook
3. The issues and merge requests reference facebook repositories (like facebookresearch/metaseq) but clicking them redirects to GitHub (github.com)
4. The GitLab instance appears to have references to facebook repositories but not the actual repositories themselves
5. Found one repository 'Byte Blaze / metaseq' which is a fork of facebookresearch/metaseq, but this is owned by Byte Blaze user, not facebook
6. Could not locate any actual facebook-owned repositories within this GitLab instance to fork

Conclusion: The facebook repositories referenced in this GitLab instance appear to be external GitHub repositories (github.com/facebookresearch/...), not actual repositories hosted within this GitLab instance. Therefore, there are no facebook repositories to fork within this GitLab environment.
